dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1861 by David S. Harley in the District Court of the district of Michigan."

"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1861 by David S. Harley in the District Court of the district of Michigan." LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into 4 panels to enable folding. Include business directories, distance table, insets of Kalamazoo, Augusta, Schoolcraft, Brady, Galesburgh, views of residential, public, and commercial properties. LC Land ownership maps, 336 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
